## Overview

- Sep 1 (Tuesday): in-person lecture
- Sep 3 (Thursday): in-person lecture, quiz 1


## Tuesday, Sep 1 (in-person)

 Today we will introduce ourselves, go over the [syllabus](../../syllabus.html), and get started with Chapter 1.  
 
 To prepare for Thursday's quiz, you should finish Chapter 1 homework questions for additional practice (recall that homework is not collected in this class) after today's class.

## Thursday, Sep 3 (in-person)

Today we will have our very first quiz!  As a reminder, quizzes in this class will be administered on Moodle but MUST BE TAKEN IN PERSON.  **Quiz 1** will be similar to the questions in [Chapter 1](../../course_documents/all_lectures/chapter_1_slide.html): you will be given some variables and you will be asked to identify their *measure types* (nominal, ordinal, continuous/scale, or dichotomous).

We will also get started with Chapter 2. [Link to fullscreen](../../course_documents/all_lectures/chapter_2_slide.html)
